links.outcome: Protocol adherence of LLM recommendations with loose prompt vs. constrained deterministic template with safety-message default
links.effect: Loose prompt: 96/300 (32%) protocol-adherent with unsafe recommendations; constrained deterministic template: 300/300 (100%) adherent, p < 0.001.
links.quote: The improvement from Phase 1 to Phase 2 was highly significant (32% vs. 100%, p < 0.001, Fisher’s exact test).

links.outcome: Input completeness and plausibility validation before generating recommendations
links.effect: Model refused to output without six valid inputs, combined with other constraints; Phase 2 achieved 100% adherence. The input check effect was not isolated or tested separately.
links.quote: The model did not generate recommendations unless all six values were provided, eliminating errors from incomplete or ambiguous data.

links.outcome: Output reproducibility and safety of loosely prompted LLM outputs across simulated inputs
links.effect: Loosely structured prompting produced variable outputs; only 96 of 300 (32%) were fully protocol-adherent, with ESA titration errors and timing violations.
links.quote: In Phase 1, when evaluated with a loosely structured prompt, AnemiaCare HD produced variable outputs.

links.outcome: Unsafe dosing recommendations in baseline LLM outputs (ESA and IV iron)
links.effect: Phase 1 outputs included continuing ESA despite Hb >12.5 g/dL and IV iron with ferritin >1,200 ng/mL; only 32% protocol-adherent.
links.quote: In several cases, the model advised continuing ESA despite Hb levels above 12.5 g/dL, where discontinuation is required, or suggested IV iron for patients with ferritin greater than 1,200 ng/mL, raising concern for iron overload.

links.outcome: Fixed output template with default safety message blocking unsupported recommendations
links.effect: With constrained template and safety defaults in Phase 2, unsafe recommendations were eliminated (300/300 adherent) versus frequent unsafe outputs in Phase 1. Effect is confounded with other prompt changes.
links.quote: Unsafe recommendations were avoided entirely: ESA was consistently withheld when Hb exceeded the limit, and iron was stopped when ferritin was too high.

links.quote: In contrast, deterministic prompting in Phase 2 resulted in 100% adherence across all 300 cases, eliminating protocol deviations, unsafe iron dosing, and timing violations (p < 0.001).
